messages:
elena: quick design review — security console: audit logs + retention + encryption labels. couple of small nits, mostly copy and a11y. can ppl skim? :eyes:
alex: on it. where are the screens? link pls.
elena: https://redwood.mock/console/security/ui-2026-03 — go to 'Audit & Retention' card, top-right kebab -> 'View schema'. i pasted screenshots in the doc.
priya: first pass — the KMS badge reads 'KMS' in uppercase and it's not clear if it's customer-managed. can we change to 'Customer-managed key (KMS)' in the badge and add a tooltip: 'Keys managed by your cloud provider / KMS. Redwood does not persist key material.'
jamie: +1 on the tooltip. also the color contrast for the badge is 3.8:1 atm. needs to be >=4.5:1 for body text. can we darken the badge border or use a stronger background? :a11y: 
chris: accessibility + copy: audit log table header is `Actor` — that's ambiguous. Suggest `Performed by` as primary label and a secondary tooltip `user or service account that initiated the action` so screen readers get context.
alex: also noticed retention microcopy: currently says "Data retention: 90" — missing units. change to `Data retention: 90 days` and make the hyphenated helper copy 'Logs are retained for X days and then deleted' instead of 'kept for X'.
elena: good catch. can we avoid brittle phrasing like 'deleted'? legal asked for 'permanently removed' in a few places. maybe helper copy: 'Logs are retained for 90 days and then permanently removed.'
priya: suggest the edit for the retention dropdown — currently the default option is 'Global default (90)' which again misses units. change to `Global default (90 days)` and in the select aria-label include `Select retention period in days`.
jamie: region selector nit: order is alphabetical by region code (us-east-1, eu-west-1) but PM wanted locale-aware priority: put user's default region first, then 'Recommended' grouping, then full list. keyboard nav currently jumps to the end after selecting. focus should stay on the control and announce new selection: use `aria-live` update.
chris: small QA on encryption row: we have two icons next to key name — a padlock and a small shield. screen readers read 'lock shield' which is unhelpful. add `aria-hidden="true"` to decorative icons and include visually-hidden text `Encryption: customer-managed key` for the row.
elena: perfect. final microcopy suggestions to paste into the doc: 1) Badge label: `Customer-managed key (KMS)` 2) Badge tooltip: `Keys managed by your cloud provider (KMS). Redwood does not persist key material.` 3) Retention label: `Data retention: 90 days` 4) Retention helper: `Logs are retained for 90 days and then permanently removed.` 5) Audit header: `Performed by` with tooltip `User or service account that initiated this event` 6) Region select note: `Recommended regions appear first based on account settings`
alex: will update the Figma and add contrast pass. i'll push new tokens to the styles file.
priya: i'll update copy in the components repo — put the strings behind `i18n.security.retention` and add tests. example JSON: {"i18n.security.retention":"Logs are retained for {days} days and then permanently removed."}
jamie: I'll handle the a11y fixes and test with VoiceOver and NVDA. will post results here.
chris: quick question — do we need legal sign-off on the word 'permanently'? if so, flagging now.
elena: legal already okayed 'permanently removed' for audit logs but not for backups. noted.
deploy-bot: design-review-bot: checklist updated — labels, tooltips, a11y notes added to ticket SEC-4212.
elena: thanks all — i'll schedule a 15m follow-up after changes land. :thumbsup:
